name: Castejón del Puente (Spain)
description: Blue field with a white-edged lozenge at the centre bearing the arms of Castejón del Puente (a castle above a bridge and waves, and a Maltese cross).
history: Municipal flag of Castejón del Puente; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Castejón del Puente arms — castle above a bridge and waves, with a Maltese cross
